page.layout: One page of text: running title ornament at top, title block centred, then verse in one column; marginal notes and marks at the right edge of the column; catchword "Quippe" at lower right below the last line.

p.i: Et cor iam meditans ad illam abire

page.notes: Marginal marks at right edge (small reference marks and a few brackets) are not legible enough to transcribe as notes. The "Quippe" at lower right is treated as catchword. Title block lines are set in mixed capitals and italic; the ornamental initial "V" is a woodcut letter joined to "Vm". Some words in the verse are uncertain due to scan quality.
